assay_id__iedb_iri.description: The url for this assay on the IEDB site

reference__iedb_iri.description: The url for the reference this assay is derived from on the IEDB site

reference__type.description: Reference type, which may be Literature, Submission, Dual (submission with publication), or Live (submission with evolving data)

reference__pmid.description: The PubMed identifier for Literature and Dual reference types

reference__submission_id.description: The identifier of the submission for Submission and Dual reference types

reference__journal.description: The journal name for Literature and Dual reference types

epitope__iedb_iri.description: The url for the epitope this assay is specific for on the IEDB site

epitope__object_type.description: The object type of the epitope, which may include Linear and Discontinuous peptides, as well as Nonpeptidic structures

epitope__name.description: A short description of the epitope, including its sequence or structure and any post translational modifications

epitope__reference_name.description: The name used by the authors for this epitope

epitope__modified_residues.description: The amino acid and its position within the epitope sequence that has a post-translational modifification

epitope__modifications.description: The type of post-translational modification that the specified residue has

epitope__starting_position.description: The starting position of the epitope within its source reference protein, for Linear peptides

epitope__ending_position.description: The ending position of the epitope within its source reference protein, for Linear peptides

epitope__iri.description: For nonpeptidic epitopes, the url for the epitope structure. Is often a ChEBI identifier

epitope__synonyms.description: For nonpeptidic epitopes, synonyms for the epitope structure

epitope__source_molecule.description: The protein or nonpeptidic structure name that the epitope is derived from

epitope__source_molecule_iri.description: The url to an identifier for the protein or nonpeptidic structure that the epitope is derived from. This is often a link to UniProt, but may also be PDB, GenBank, or ChEBI, ONTIE

epitope__molecule_parent.description: The reference proteome protein name that the epitope is derived from

epitope__molecule_parent_iri.description: The url to an identifier for the reference proteome protein that the epitope is derived from. This is often a link to UniProt, but may also be PDB, GenBank, ONTIE

epitope__source_organism.description: The organism name that the epitope is derived from

epitope__source_organism_iri.description: The url to an identifier for the organism that the epitope is derived from. This is usually a link to NCBI, but will be ONTIE, if the species is beyond the scope of NCBI taxonomy

epitope__species.description: The species of the organism that the epitope is derived from

epitope__species_iri.description: The url to an identifier for the species that the epitope is derived from. This is a link to NCBI

epitope__epitope_comments.description: Textual comments regarding the epitope provided by the IEDB curator

host__name.description: The name of the organism whose T cell response is being measured

host__geolocation.description: The geographic location of the host at the time of study

host__geolocation_iri.description: The url to an identifier for the geolocation. This will be alink to the Gazetteer ontology

host__age.description: The age or age range for the host(s) tested
